annotations.title: Start a ladder for a club

description: Use when someone wants a rating ladder for their own chess club, class or group. Give the club's Lichess team or chess.com club as a link, an id or a name. Returns the club as found, a Start page link with that club filled in, what the free plan and the Club pass include, and the Discord app link when the club uses Discord. The organizer creates the ladder in the browser from that link; this tool creates nothing.

club.description: A Lichess team link (lichess.org/team/...), a chess.com club link (chess.com/club/...), a team id or club slug, or the club's name.

site.description: Which site the club is on. Needed only when club is a bare id; narrows a name search.

uses_discord.description: True when the club has a Discord server, false when it has none. Leave out when not known.

name: start_club_ladder
title: Start a ladder for a club
